content:
When I open a file of mathlib's fork in VS code, it automatically starts compling, starting to download packages. Do we have a way to stop it? Thanks.
(This is disaterous if I try to switch branch with different commit on upstream. Then because of the well known network issue, things won't work in a very height rate even after I uniform the commit on upstream.)
A problem might be related is why we (with similar network issue) often have failing lake exe cache get on proofwidgets? Is there a reason for it?

I think this is what's causing the automatic downloads, so the issue is in elan and not the VSCode extention.
It should only happen if you switched toolchains, i.e. if your branches differ in the contents of ./lean-toolchain.
(unless you set lean4.automaticallyBuildDependencies, but you probably didn't)
Also I just noticed the extension has a setting lean4.alwaysAskBeforeInstallingLeanVersions, maybe this solves everything?

It is really wierd that I have both branches in 4.30.0-rc1, then it started downloading plausible, I have no idea why.

Thanks anyway, it patly solves my problem.

Oh I know why! Because #37783 was recently merged
So maybe changes to ./lake-manifest.json also cause auto-downloads
Thanks, this indeed give good reason to this and all I met previously.
